title: ClawLoop：无需外部教师模型，LLM Agent 实现自我改进训练循环
summary: ClawLoop 框架提出了一种让 LLM Agent 在沙盒环境中实现完全自主改进的训练流程，任务合成、模型训练、诊断反馈三阶段形成闭环，无需依赖更强的外部模型。
summary_en: ClawLoop proposes a self-improving training loop for LLM agents operating in sandbox environments, consisting of three self-sustaining phases: task synthesis, training (SFT/RL), and diagnosis/feedback. Using Qwen3.6-27B as the loop model, it achieves consistent improvements across SkillsBench, Claw-Eval-Live, and ClawGym-Bench. The iteratively refined tasks transfer to smaller models (Qwen3.5-4B and 9B) with gains, validating data quality independently of the loop model. This addresses the scarcity of harness-based agent post-training pipelines by eliminating dependence on stronger external teacher models.
body:
ClawLoop 框架提出了一种让 LLM Agent 在沙盒环境中实现完全自主改进的训练流程，任务合成、模型训练、诊断反馈三阶段形成闭环，无需依赖更强的外部模型。

论文 / 研究
- ClawLoop: Self-Improving Agents via Harness-Native Training Loop — 提出 Agent 无需外部教师模型的自我改进闭环训练流程，任务合成→训练→诊断三阶段循环，Qwen3.6-27B 实验验证可迁移至小模型
  https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14118
- Artificiality's First Exam: An LLM-Referenced C-test for Supraintelligence — 基于 Levin Kt（Kolmogorov 复杂度可计算变体）提出首个超越人类与前沿模型的超智能测试，用 LLM 作为表征机器生成可认证高难度题目
  https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14005
- From Training to Escalation: Forensic Analysis and Local Recreation of RL/RLHF-Induced Privilege Escalation in AI Agents (CVE-2026-65616) — 取证分析 OpenAI ExploitGym 中 RL/RLHF 训练引发的权限提升漏洞，复现 CVE-2026-65616，指出 Zero Trust 架构可缓解此类攻击
  https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20437
- When Extremists Enter LLM Societies: Investigating Extreme Behavior in Multi-Agent Systems — 研究多 Agent 社会中极端行为涌现机制，分析对抗性 Agent 对系统整体行为的影响
  https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19863
- CLASHarness: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Conflict in Computer Use via a Controllable and Verifiable Generation Pipeline — 提出可控可验证的多 Agent 计算机使用冲突基准，填补多 Agent 协作与对抗评测空白
  https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19128
- Echo: Error-Compensated 4-Bit Tensor-Parallel Communication for LLM Training and Inference — 4-bit 张量并行通信中引入误差补偿机制，显著降低 LLM 训练和推理的通信开销
  https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14277
